declared_intent: Organize only user-selected invoice files while preserving originals and protecting financial metadata.

allowed_by_default: Read user-selected invoice files or folders.
Extract invoice metadata for local reports.
Write organized copies and manifests to approved output folders.
confirmation_required: Moving, renaming, deleting, or overwriting originals.
denied_by_default: Reading unrelated financial, tax, or banking files.
Printing sensitive invoice data into public logs.

token_optimization: Move extraction schemas, naming rules, and checklist logic into config/validators.
selection_precision: Trigger only for invoice organization and metadata extraction, not broad finance advice.
review_status: preview-only; user should review before installation
